snippet.title: Would you help me draw a picture? - Visual novel animated trailer
snippet.description:
A short visual novel about a girl struggling to finish her picture. Would you be able to help her?
Play for free here no download required: https://slavomir.itch.io/would-you-help-me-draw-a-picture
If you liked the game and want to support my future projects feel free to check out my patreon here :
https://www.patreon.com/SlavomirAsenov
